notes: No new samples were downloaded and no target was executed during this investigation.
Packing evidence for the local pool was produced by read-only upx -t sweeps, see .data/verification/upx-sweep-raw.json.
Only UPX can be unpacked automatically; other packers are detected but not handled.
Filenames, version resources and packing clues do not establish formal qualification.

candidates.name: Ollama
candidates.flaw_class: path traversal to arbitrary file write; missing authentication
candidates.adapter_fit: WINDOWS_ORIGINAL_PE64 CLI plus a small local driver for the rogue registry
gaps: License scope of the distributed build
candidates.notes: Highest brand recognition among locally deployed LLM software. Exploitation needs a local mock registry.

candidates.name: Langflow
candidates.flaw_class: unauthenticated code injection leading to RCE via POST /api/v1/validate/code
candidates.windows_entry: pip installed python package with a local HTTP service
candidates.adapter_fit: WINDOWS_PYTHON_CALL plus a small HTTP driver
candidates.notes: Lowest exploitation complexity of the shortlist: a single unauthenticated POST executes code.

candidates.affected_range: see the advisories for the pinned version

candidates.adapter_fit: WINDOWS_PYTHON_CALL plus a small HTTP driver

candidates.name: llama-cpp-python
candidates.flaw_class: unsandboxed Jinja2 chat_template from GGUF metadata leading to SSTI and RCE
candidates.windows_entry: pip installed python package, CPU only
candidates.adapter_fit: WINDOWS_PYTHON_CALL, but a real GGUF exceeds the 128 KiB fixture limit
gaps: Realistic input size within the fixture limit
candidates.notes: Component level verification is easy; whole software verification needs the crafted GGUF inside the snapshot.

categories.hard_constraint: The distributed object must really be UPX packed, because UPX is the only packer the product can unpack.

local_pool_finding.conclusion: Main executables of mainstream closed source freeware are rarely UPX packed; UPX appears mainly in installers, self extracting packages and a few bundled components.

candidates.name: UPX packed installers already on disk (IrfanView 4.33 setup, Media Jukebox 8.0.400 setup)
candidates.flaw_class: to be determined: extraction path traversal, arbitrary file placement, temporary directory hijack
gaps: Whether an installer counts as the software under this requirement

candidates.name: Closed source command line tool pool to be downloaded and screened
candidates.adapter_fit: WINDOWS_ORIGINAL_PE32/PE64 CLI, SANITIZER or FILE_CREATED observer

candidates.name: WinRAR before 6.23
candidates.flaw_class: archive handling leading to execution of an unintended file
candidates.adapter_fit: uncertain: the known exploit path requires a user opening a file inside the archive, command line reproduction is unverified
gaps: Command line reachability of the flaw
candidates.warning: CVE-2022-30333 affects UnRAR on Linux and UNIX only; WinRAR is explicitly unaffected, do not use it as a Windows acceptance case.

usable_tools: built in XOR and Base64 heuristics

selection_criteria_ranked: Command line entry that accepts a file argument
String level protection visible in the binary so FLOSS recovers partial plaintext
A public parsing type flaw with a comparable fixed version
Moderate size; avoid large GUI products with strong virtualisation

candidates.name: Closed source freeware pool to be downloaded and screened for string level obfuscation
candidates.notes: Overlaps heavily with the P-B pool; one screening pass should produce both a UPX shortlist and a string protection observation.

candidates.name: TeamViewer 15.64.7, Zoom, AnyDesk 9.0.4 (existing pool)
candidates.notes: Large size, GUI only, no command line driver, protection strength beyond the toolchain. Poor cost benefit.

blocking_questions: Does 具备加壳功能闭源软件 mean a packed closed source software or a closed source software that itself provides packing, such as WinRAR or Bandizip? The same question applies to 具备混淆功能.
Can a packed installer or self extracting package be the audited object for the packing requirement? If yes, two UPX confirmed objects are already on disk.

toolchain_finding.issue: The script requires PowerShell 7 (#requires -Version 7.0) but this host only has Windows PowerShell 5.1, so it cannot run as written.
toolchain_finding.workaround_used: An equivalent read only Python pipeline calling upx -t with before and after SHA-256 comparison.
toolchain_finding.recommendation: Lower the requirement to 5.1 or port the script to Python so that clean environment acceptance does not break again.
